description:
## Problem
ledger-seed-recut-after-published-results-advance-20261111 requires that 'any removal or legacy-overlay change has owner approval'. The recut moved 2 read_primitives entries from legacy_overlay to accepted (#4317), and the #4340 branch moves 9 TPC-DI entries more (9 to 12), without recorded approval. The moves follow published-results moving forward.

## Change
List each moved entry with its digest, the published-results commit that justifies it, and the effect on ranking. The owner approves or the moves are reverted.

## Decision gates
Blocked until the owner answers per entry group (2 merged, 9 pending on #4340).

## Verification rubric
Pass: every legacy-overlay change in the seed since 8aaa9921f7 has a recorded approval or is reverted; the seed check passes.

## Guardrails
- Any limit, default, threshold or label text is shown to the owner before it is committed.
- The implementer never resolves review threads on its own pull request; the reviewer or the owner does.
- No polling loop around `make pr-arm`, no `--no-verify`, and no stand-in review unless the owner names the PR and head unprompted.
- Heavy work runs only through `make heavy-run` or a lock-taking entry point.
- Status reports state only what merged and what was verified, with the evidence.
